question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left winger, Bob is playing right back, Claire is playing fullback, Dave is playing left midfielder, and Eve is playing center midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Dave trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Dave and Bob trade positions. Then, Alice and Dave trade positions. Finally, Dave and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) left winger
(B) right back
(C) fullback
(D) left midfielder
(E) center midfielder
solution:
Positions in order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve
Initial: left winger | right back | fullback | left midfielder | center midfielder
1. Claire–Dave: left winger | right back | left midfielder | fullback | center midfielder
2. Alice–Claire: left midfielder | right back | left winger | fullback | center midfielder
3. Dave–Bob: left midfielder | fullback | left winger | right back | center midfielder
4. Alice–Dave: right back | fullback | left winger | left midfielder | center midfielder
5. Dave–Eve: right back | fullback | left winger | center midfielder | left midfielder
Dave plays center midfielder, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
